correctness.rationale: The hook-length degree formula was reconstructed from the primary Grassmannian/tableau formula. Symmetry is immediate. The ratio \(D_{n,k+1}/D_{n,k}=\prod_{j=1}^{h}(m+j)/(k+j)\), with \(h=n-2k-1>0\) and \(m=k(n-k)\), is strictly greater than one before the center. For the first curvature inequality, \(Q_n=D_{n,3}/D_{n,2}^2=2(n-2)(n-1)!(3n-9)!/(2n-4)!^2\), with \(Q_{11}=437/442<1\), \(Q_{12}=3795/2584>1\), and \(Q_{n+1}/Q_n-1\) has positive numerator \(11(n-5)^3+94(n-5)^2+199(n-5)+56\) for \(n\ge5\). Exact enumeration of the finite side \(2\le n\le11\) completes the iff. The repository verifier reproduces these identities and finite checks; it is corroborative, not the infinite proof.
correctness.risk: The finite half uses exact enumeration only after the infinite monotonicity reduction has isolated the required finite range.

final_claim: For fixed \(n\), the Plücker degrees \(D_{n,k}=\deg\operatorname{Gr}(k,\mathbb C^n)\) rise strictly toward the center, and the sequence in \(k\) is log-concave exactly for \(n\le 11\); for every \(n\ge12\) log-concavity already fails at \(k=2\).
limitations: No claim is made about log-concavity in other Grassmannian parameters or other homogeneous varieties.
